title: eludite.project.set_item_properties input
description: Change a file's Build Action, Copy to Output Directory, Custom Tool or Custom Tool Namespace (brief 0081): written to the project file with its formatting kept (an Update item for a file of the SDK's default globs), then the solution reloads.

path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to the solution folder.

project.description: The project listing the file, by name or path. Default: the first project of the solution that lists it.

build_action.description: The item type: None, Compile, Content, EmbeddedResource, AdditionalFiles, Page, ...

copy_to_output.description: never (Do not copy), always (Copy always), preserve_newest (Copy if newer).

custom_tool.description: The Generator metadata; empty removes it.

custom_tool_namespace.description: The CustomToolNamespace metadata; empty removes it.
